faq.a: A template lets you make ads in minutes without booking a creator or shoot. Try different messages when you need fresh ads.
faq.q: Why use a template instead of hiring a creator?

faq.a: Yes. Add your own product photos, clips, and logo to the template. Your ad can show the item you actually sell.
faq.q: Can I use my own pictures and clips?

faq.a: Yes. Add a product photo, choose the message, and generate an ad. You do not need filming or editing experience.
faq.q: Can I use a template without video editing experience?

faq.a: A product ad template is a ready-made video layout with an opening, scenes, and voice. Add your product to make a creator-style ad in minutes.
faq.q: What is a product ad template?

faq.a: A template gives you the opening, scenes, and pace, so you can make an ad faster. Focus on your product and offer.
faq.q: Why not build the ad from a blank page?

faq.a: Templates work for beauty, clothing, food, home goods, electronics, and many other products. Change the scene and message to fit your buyers.
faq.q: Which industries are these templates for?

faq.a: Yes. Use your watermark-free video in paid ads, product pages, or client work. Use only product media you have rights to.
faq.q: Can I use the download in a paid ad?

faq.a: Yes. Videos use 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Failed jobs return credits.
faq.q: Do these ad templates cost credits to use?

faq.a: Product sellers, marketers, and agencies can use these templates. Start with a photo and make ads for different products or buyers.
faq.q: Who should use a product ad template?

faq.a: Add your product photo or link, choose a message, and generate the video. The template gives you a ready-made structure without editing from scratch.
faq.q: How does a template become an ad I can post?

workspaceCases.label: Close-Up Unboxing: Makeup Tools
workspaceCases.prompt:
A 15-second vertical 9:16 premium product texture film for a coral makeup brush roll from a kraft mailer at a bright bedroom vanity.

【Reference】The uploaded product photo is the only product reference. Reproduce the coral makeup brush roll exactly — same shape, proportions, colour, material, finish and details — and never show a second one or a changed part.
【Overall Style】Premium product film, restrained palette taken from the product, quiet negative space, one controlled light source, no gloss exaggeration. One controlled key light raking across the surface, a cool rim separating the outline, deep shadow falling away from the product.
【Product Lock】The coral makeup brush roll keeps the same shape, colour, material, finish and details in every frame, including a close unboxing that lifts your makeup tools; nothing is added, removed or recoloured and the quantity never changes.
【Action Logic】One real action, followed from start to finish in one place, with the product never leaving the frame. Each beat is a step of that action, and no beat invents a different event, a different place or a second product.
【0.0-4.0s | Ambience】The coral makeup brush roll at rest from a kraft mailer at a bright bedroom vanity, the key light travelling across its surface. Camera drifts slowly.
【4.0-8.0s | Use moment】Adult hands lift a coral makeup brush roll and two unbranded brushes from a kraft mailer at a bright bedroom vanity. Camera moves with the hands, no cut.
【8.0-12.0s | Material】A macro of the material where the light reacts with it: the surface described by what the light does, not by an adjective. Visible here: a close unboxing that lifts your makeup tools.
【12.0-15.0s | Hold】The coral makeup brush roll returns to the opening light, centred and complete. Camera pulls back and holds.
【Camera】Slow drift at 50mm, one 85mm push in and one arc that ends on the same side, all on one axis. No handheld, no whip pan, no speed ramp.
【Sound】Voice: no spoken dialogue in this film; the track carries the mood, not a claim. Effects: a quiet room tone and one soft handling sound. BGM: a minimal ambient bed, low, instrumental, no vocals.
【Continuity】The coral makeup brush roll stays identical from the first frame to the last, the hands keep correct anatomy, and the same light and screen direction carry between beats, so nothing teleports. Final frame: the product centred and unchanged from the first frame.
【Negative】no readable text, numbers, signs or labels anywhere in the frame; no logos, brand marks or watermark; no extra or swapped product and no changed parts; no distorted hands or warped anatomy; no flicker, colour shift or shape drift of the product; no price, discount badge or promotional graphic; no handheld shake, no fast cut, no lens flare, no invented surface.

@graph.name: UGC Ad Template Gallery | AIVideosUGC
@graph.description: Browse a gallery of UGC and product ad templates. Find a style, add your own product photo, and generate the ad in a few minutes without writing a prompt.

mainEntity.name: Why use a template instead of hiring a creator?

acceptedAnswer.text: A template lets you make ads in minutes without booking a creator or shoot. Try different messages when you need fresh ads.

mainEntity.name: Can I use my own pictures and clips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add your own product photos, clips, and logo to the template. Your ad can show the item you actually sell.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a template without video editing experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add a product photo, choose the message, and generate an ad. You do not need filming or editing experience.

mainEntity.name: What is a product ad template?

acceptedAnswer.text: A product ad template is a ready-made video layout with an opening, scenes, and voice. Add your product to make a creator-style ad in minutes.

mainEntity.name: Why not build the ad from a blank page?

acceptedAnswer.text: A template gives you the opening, scenes, and pace, so you can make an ad faster. Focus on your product and offer.

mainEntity.name: Which industries are these templates for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Templates work for beauty, clothing, food, home goods, electronics, and many other products. Change the scene and message to fit your buyers.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the download in a paid ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use your watermark-free video in paid ads, product pages, or client work. Use only product media you have rights to.

mainEntity.name: Do these ad templates cost credits to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Videos use 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Failed jobs return credits.

mainEntity.name: Who should use a product ad template?

acceptedAnswer.text: Product sellers, marketers, and agencies can use these templates. Start with a photo and make ads for different products or buyers.

mainEntity.name: How does a template become an ad I can post?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add your product photo or link, choose a message, and generate the video. The template gives you a ready-made structure without editing from scratch.

mainEntity.name: Where can I publish the ad from these layouts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Publish template ads on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, or your store. Choose a video size that fits each placement.

mainEntity.name: Can I make Black Friday ads for several products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use a photo or link for each product and make a separate ad. Try different openings to see which offer gets attention.

mainEntity.name: Can I make different sizes for each ad placement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose 9:16 for vertical feeds, 1:1 for square feeds, or 16:9 for wide placements. Other sizes include 4:3 and 3:4.

mainEntity.name: Can I add music and product photos to a Black Friday ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use your product photo, choose music, and add your confirmed sale offer. You can make the ad without filming a new product video.

mainEntity.name: Can a product link start a Black Friday ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Paste your product link to bring in its photos and details. Add the sale offer, then check that the ad matches the product page.

mainEntity.name: Can I start a Black Friday ad from my store listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Paste the product listing and use its photos to make a sale ad. Review the product details and discount before posting.

mainEntity.name: When should I make my Black Friday ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make the product scenes early, then add the final discount, code, and end date once they are confirmed. Check every offer before posting.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Black Friday ad cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A photo costs 24 credits. Videos cost 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30; failed jobs return credits.

mainEntity.name: Can I add an end date to my sale ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add the confirmed end date and time to your message or captions. Check them before posting so customers see the right offer.

mainEntity.name: Can I post Black Friday ads on TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Download the ad without a watermark and post it on TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook. Choose the size that fits each placement.

mainEntity.name: Can I reuse the ad after Black Friday?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Change the sale message, dates, and captions for your next promotion. You can reuse the product scene without another shoot.

mainEntity.name: Can an AI actor announce my Black Friday sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose an AI actor to speak your sale message beside the product. You do not need to hire a creator for each offer.

@graph.description: Get photos that follow Amazon product image requirements. Start from a picture you already have, make the main image pure white, and add it in Seller Central.

mainEntity.name: Can I prepare Amazon images for many products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Make consistent white-background and lifestyle images across your catalog without new photo shoots. Each image costs 24 credits, and failed jobs return credits.

mainEntity.name: Will you upload my photos to Amazon?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Download the finished files and add them in Seller Central yourself. You control when each listing changes.

mainEntity.name: What happens if my Amazon image breaks the rules?

acceptedAnswer.text: Amazon may hide the listing until you replace the image. Main images have stricter rules than other listing photos, so check them before publishing.

mainEntity.name: What other photos should I add to an Amazon listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add close-ups, a view that shows size, and photos of the product in use. Use these after the white-background main image.

mainEntity.name: Can I make an Amazon product video without filming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Make a video from your product photo or link without booking a shoot. Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

mainEntity.name: Can my catalog tool request Amazon images?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use the API to request product images from your catalog tool. You review the files and upload them to Amazon yourself.

mainEntity.name: What should an Amazon main image show?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Amazon main image should show only the product on a pure white background, with no text or props. Check Amazon’s current image rules before uploading.

mainEntity.name: Can I add words to Amazon listing images?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, add helpful text to secondary images when Amazon allows it. Keep the main image free of text, badges, and slogans.

mainEntity.name: Can I make a white Amazon main image from my photo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Upload your product photo and replace its background with pure white. Download the new image and check its edges before adding it to your listing.

【Reference】The uploaded product photo is the only product reference. Reproduce the canvas Tote exactly — same shape, proportions, colour, material, finish and details — and never show a second one or a changed part.
【Overall Style】Premium product film, restrained palette taken from the product, quiet negative space, one controlled light source, no gloss exaggeration. One controlled key light raking across the surface, a cool rim separating the outline, deep shadow falling away from the product.
【Product Lock】The canvas Tote keeps the same shape, colour, material, finish and details in every frame, including the full shape; nothing is added, removed or recoloured and the quantity never changes.
【Action Logic】One real action, followed from start to finish in one place, with the product never leaving the frame. Each beat is a step of that action, and no beat invents a different event, a different place or a second product.
【0.0-4.0s | Ambience】The canvas Tote at rest in a real room, the key light travelling across its surface. Camera drifts slowly.
【4.0-8.0s | Use moment】The product turns slowly where it stands, the light crossing the surface as it moves. Camera moves with it, no cut.
【8.0-12.0s | Material】A macro of the material where the light reacts with it: the surface described by what the light does, not by an adjective. Visible here: the full shape.
【12.0-15.0s | Hold】The canvas Tote returns to the opening light, centred and complete. Camera pulls back and holds.
【Camera】Slow drift at 50mm, one 85mm push in and one arc that ends on the same side, all on one axis. No handheld, no whip pan, no speed ramp.
【Sound】Voice: no spoken dialogue in this film; the track carries the mood, not a claim. Effects: a quiet room tone and one soft handling sound. BGM: a minimal ambient bed, low, instrumental, no vocals.
【Continuity】The canvas Tote stays identical from the first frame to the last, the hands keep correct anatomy, and the same light and screen direction carry between beats, so nothing teleports. Final frame: the product centred and unchanged from the first frame.
【Negative】no readable text, numbers, signs or labels anywhere in the frame; no logos, brand marks or watermark; no extra or swapped product and no changed parts; no distorted hands or warped anatomy; no flicker, colour shift or shape drift of the product; no price, discount badge or promotional graphic; no handheld shake, no fast cut, no lens flare, no invented surface.
